author: agent
text: Used for display in before_edit briefings and error messages where the full qualname would be noisy. Calls base_of first to strip disambiguators (method/2 -> method, name#3 -> name), then takes the last segment after splitting on dots. Examples: 'memway.indexer.Indexer.resolve' -> 'resolve', 'Type.method/2' -> 'method'. This preserves disambiguation-stripping consistency: only base_of knows the suffix rules, and short_of delegates to it rather than reimplementing them. Related: query.py:before_edit._short wraps this for the radius display.

text: SUPERSEDES the "display" note below, which was wrong. Call-site audit shows this is load-bearing RESOLUTION INFRASTRUCTURE, not cosmetic formatting: indexer.py:928 keys the suffix index with short_of(q), and :931 queries it with short_of(ref) - this is what lets a bare emitted 'separateCamelCase' match an entity registered as 'separateCamelCase/2', the fix that took gson from 0 to 3,150 method-level call edges in 0.56.0. verify.py:172 builds the name-hit tier's short-name set. query.py:_short (module-level, not before_edit._short) wraps this and feeds the unresolved-reference counter at :85, not "radius display". test_corpus_recall.py normalizes the oracle. A note calling this cosmetic invites exactly the "it's only formatting" edit that would break edge resolution repo-wide. The delegation to base_of is correct - refs.py is the sole reader of reference spellings, enforced by a structural pin.

author: agent
text:
AMENDS the correction below on one detail; its substance is right and stands. That entry cites "indexer.py:928" and ":931" for the suffix index. Those lines moved in 0.57.1 when the lookup was extracted from Indexer.resolve into Indexer.candidates - the code is identical, the numbers are not. Read it as Indexer.candidates: it keys _suffix_index with short_of(q) and queries it with short_of(ref).

Worth noting HOW this decayed, because the map could not catch it. This note is stamped against refs.short_of, which did not change, so it is not stale and never would have been - the claim that rotted points at a DIFFERENT file. Comment rot is bounded by an entity's own hash (CLAUDE.md lesson 12); a cross-file line citation has no such boundary and nothing will ever flag it. That is the argument for the rule the confirms on Indexer have followed since 0.54.0: cite the symbol, not the line. Amended here rather than rewritten, so the reasoning stays readable.

The substance is unchanged and still load-bearing: short_of is resolution infrastructure, not display. It is what lets a bare emitted `separateCamelCase` reach an entity registered as `separateCamelCase/2` - gson, 0 to 3,150 method-level call edges in 0.56.0 - and in 0.57.1 it is also the key on both sides of candidates(), which is now the single lookup behind both resolve() and the unresolved-reference counter. An edit made on the belief that this is cosmetic formatting would break edge resolution repo-wide.
